title: Minimizing Block-Cipher Calls for n-Bit-Secure DAE
summary: The target is n-bit security for block-cipher-based DAE, while finding a construction with the fewest possible block-cipher calls remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: For deterministic authenticated encryption (DAE) schemes based on block ciphers, can one construct a scheme that achieves $n$-bit security while minimizing the number of block-cipher calls?

scope.domain: Design of block-cipher-based deterministic authenticated encryption schemes.
parameters: n: target security level in bits
block-cipher call count: efficiency quantity to minimize
scope.unresolved_remainder: Construct a block-cipher-based DAE scheme that achieves n-bit security while minimizing the number of block-cipher calls.

citations.label: Towards Optimally Secure Deterministic Authenticated Encryption Schemes

progress.summary: The paper explicitly presents this construction goal as its primary research question.
citation_labels: Yu Long Chen et al., Towards Optimally Secure Deterministic Authenticated Encryption Schemes
